slides.title: 4 fixes for when you're on a job
body: Most callers won't leave a voicemail.

slides.title: Auto text-back
body: Many business phone apps can text missed callers automatically. Turn it on.

slides.title: A booking link
body: Put it in your Google profile, Instagram bio and voicemail greeting.

slides.title: Set a reply window
body: Check messages at lunch and end of day. Reply within the hour when you can.

slides.title: Say it in your greeting
body: "Text this number for the fastest reply."

slides.title: How fast do you respond?
body: It's 1 of 15 checks in our free audit. Link in bio.
